reviews_h2: What people say after we are done

reviews.author: Martin Boykov
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about Autoshop. I have been coming here for more than 10 years bringing multiple cars and never disappointed. Clinton and Austin are always on top of the game! Honest and knowledgable mechanics! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Karen Lynn Bolton
reviews.text: I had heard about the great reviews for this shop. Convinced my spouse to take Jeep to them to repair dash control panel for heat and air. They would get it working then several weeks later it would stop again, back to shop and fixed again. Purchased a new panel which they replaced and was working fine until it wasn't. Took it back, still trusting them to correct it. They worked on it, said it works fine now, whenever they work on it they always raise the steering wheel to access the part. I paid my bill and left. When I got home I discovered my steering wheel won't adjust and guess what No Air. So now with temps from 95 to 100 nothing. I'm so disappointed because I honestly trusted these guys.

reviews.author: Ashlyn Payne
reviews.text: They have always been great on working on my car over the years. I feel very confident leaving my vehicle with them overnight because they make sure that your vehicle/ belongings stay secure! I keep going back because of the great prices and service. I absolutely LOVE the new updated lobby!

reviews.author: Bob Zink
reviews.text: The personal service you from Clinton and Austin is exemplary. I've recently called on a day they weren't even open and they went out of their way to assist. They seem to really care about the customer. They should be considered heroes with other first responders.

reviews.author: Ashley Herren
reviews.text: Best guys you'll ever meet any time I have a problem I come here they never hesitate to help me . They always help me Solve my issue and my car runs beautifully pricing is good ! Service is good ! And my car is good ! Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Shayne Ayres
reviews.text: HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE: about a month ago, I began talking to them about purchasing a vehicle. Then on Saturday this weekend, I and a few of my friends were waiting to help with a charity even going on next door at the YAS sea Haven and stayed near the side of the building so stay in the sun since it was very cold. The owner, or maybe just an employee with access to the camera, decided to set of the alarm. I will admit, I got angry and said things to the camera, saying "and to think I was about to purchase a vehicle from here" The very egotistical owner, who I assume lived nearby, then ran to the store and threatened us. We were literally there to help with a charity event for homeless youths, and we're just trying to stand in the sun Also,, important note, the business was CLOSED!! we weren't driving away any customers or business as the store was CLOSED that day. Absolutely recommend NOT going here for anything!

reviews.author: G Jones
reviews.text: My family has used The Auto Shop for years. Always excellent service & great communication. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Joe Watson
reviews.text: Nobody and I MEAN NOBODY out does these guys. They've rock stars. I have 2 cars 2011 Impala and 99 ES 300 Lexus and I wont let any other wannabe mechanic touch them. Love their slogan. We don't work on cars we fix them. They don't overcharge and honest. Thank you Austin& Clinton.

reviews.author: Jamila
reviews.text: I had to change the reservoir for my antifreeze and couldn't find anyone to do it right away. I called and the young man said "sure come on by". He was really nice and it was done in 10 mins. Very cool demeanor about him. I felt that he definitely could be trusted. Hey thanks again!

reviews.author: Sandra Landis
reviews.text: I had some work done on my vehicle...they did such a fantastic job, that when my son's car needed the engine replaced, I had his car towed there and they replaced his engine for a much lower price than we could have had it done anywhere else! I have been in the area since 1971 and Marty and his wife will be the first place I recommend to anyone that asks! Because they do such a great service, you may have to wait on availability....but well worth it to have your vehicle fixed right! What nice and honest business people!

reviews.author: Ginger Matson
reviews.text: On our first day at the beach the altanator went out on our van. We called Auto Shop and they were so nice. The gentleman I spoke too was professional and answered all my questions. He also gave me an estimate on the repairs we needed. They replaced our altanator quickly and we had our van back the same day. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Diana Hunte
reviews.text: Marty & Clinton at the Auto Shop are HONEST, FRIENDLY PROFESSIONALS that offer AFFORDABLE rates (nearly half of what other shops charge per hour)! This family owned business gave us a quote, provided the service (allowing us to bring our own parts), and charged only for the service at the rate of the original quote... these are mechanics whom know the area, efficiently manage their time in the garage, and provide quality service. Auto Shop has earned our trust.

reviews.author: Roberta Gibson
reviews.text: We are from Michigan. Amazing service. Very fair prices. Super nice Guy! We were worried about finding a repair shop for Buick and how much it would cost. You can certainly trust this place. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Deborah Hoff
reviews.text: My husband and I needed our car repaired before going out of town and Marty gave us a quick quote and repair at a very reasonable price and we were out and on our way. I would absolutely recommend this shop to anyone and everyone who needs any repair work done! Marty will take great care of you!

reviews.author: Deborah Rose Pugliese
reviews.text: I had them look at my car today to do a tuneup. He didn’t take advantage of me. He told me everything that was wrong. He kept in touch with me the whole time so that I had no surprises with the bill. I will definitely use them again. Thank you!! I also like the fact that it’s a small shop.

reviews.author: Krisi Taylor
reviews.text: Marty and Clinton at Auto Shop replaced the alternator on my Cadillac for far less money than other shops quoted me. I got it there late and they still got it done before the day was even over. Such honesty and professionalism is greatly appreciated . They definitely have my business . If you have a car problem definitely worth giving them a call

reviews.author: Shannon DeMarino
reviews.text: Marty and Clinton are the best in Myrtle Beach. I won't take any of my vehicles to anyone else ever again. They do the best work with the best prices and they don't try to rip you off of you're a female that doesn't know anything about a vehicle. They stand behind the work they do. The logo that Marty has "We don't work on 'em We fix 'em" is definitely a true statement for this mechanic shop.

reviews.author: Susan Harvey
reviews.text: Excellent workmanship, prices, and turn-around time. Even more important to me, as a woman who knows next to nothing about auto repairs, is Marty's honesty. Imagine that.....an honest mechanic! !!!!! I have been a customer for two years and will never take my 2003 Honda CR-V to anyone else.

reviews.author: Dale Weir
reviews.text: We had oil changed and brake pads put on all around . He replaced a brake light for us even repaired back end of car where tree had knocked the fender out of alignment . Very professional and courteous. We just moved to Myrtle Beach and definitely found our go to mechanic.

reviews.author: Wifey Zlove
reviews.text: I'm for Pa, and if you're looking for a fast friendly service and affordable service, you will be coming to the right place .Austin and Clinton, you were truly a blessing, and I pray that God continues to bless you and your families . Have an amazing day.

reviews.author: Barry Adams
reviews.text: I highly recommend this garage here in Myrtle Beach. Customer service is wonderful, and both of my cars are back up and running like I never had an issue. They took care of me, for a very affordable price

reviews.author: Chris Matthew
reviews.text: Seriously hands down the best service I have ever recieved from a shop, I've taken my car to 2 different shops before this one and no one was able to fix my problem they just kept suggesting to change more parts on my brakes. Coming here was a blessing, definitely recommend it, you won't regret it!

reviews.author: Laas Hess
reviews.text: Great experience and highly recommend. We had an issue that we had checked out at another shop, we were told that we are fine to drive back to Canada to go home. We didnt feel safe and had Autoshop check it and they immediately spotted the issue and repaired it.

reviews.author: Mai Ling Morgan
reviews.text: Great mechanics that do a great job without over charging. Highly recommend this place to get your car fixed. I have going there for many years.

reviews.author: Jonathan Charlton
reviews.text: The best and most reliable auto repair on the beach. Marty really knows what he is doing when it comes to repairs and he doesn't try to sell you parts and labor you don't need.

reviews.author: connie massey
reviews.text: Even tho my time was limited and I couldn't wait for the part, the owner was very nice and did not even charge me to look at it and diagnose it. Thanks so much for your compassion and understanding!!

reviews.author: Lucille Bush
reviews.text: Absolutely love them! They tell you exactly whats wrong and what it would cost. Straight to the point.

reviews.author: Cristina Valenzuela
reviews.text: Worst ever, lying inexperienced mechanics that only mess up your car, and still charge you. They claim to "fix" one thing, but then they mess up another, that's how they keep you coming back to stay in business. Avoid them like the plague they are!!!
